system.description:
Flurry Technique

Once per turn, you can spend 4 Discipline as part of casting a Bukijutsu. You cannot gain Discipline as part of casting a Bukijutsu this turn. On a hit or when a creature fails their saving throw, you can perform one of the following abilities. Once you use this Kata, you cannot use it again against the same creature until you complete a Long rest.;

Kill: If the damage dealt would cause the affected creature to have 50 or fewer hit points and they are classed as a Standard adversary, their hit points are immediately reduced to 0 instead.

Cripple: If the damage dealt would cause the affected creature to have 50 or fewer hit points and they are classed as a Standard or Elite adversary, the target must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save they become Staggered for one minute. A creature Staggered in this way can remake their save at the end of each of their turns to end this effect.
